Thanks team — quick rollup from the SF Developer Bootcamp last week. Attached: SF-bootcamp-rollup.xlsx and SF-bootcamp-leads.csv. High level: 48 raw leads, 22 MQLs, 9 SQLs to date. Marketing-attributed pipeline (HubSpot first-touch/event) shows $420,000. Sales last-touch attribution shows $295,000.

We have a specific dispute flagged for Acme (Jordan Ellis) where AE Ben is asserting direct outreach should receive full credit; marketing is counting it as event-driven because form indicated booth demo. I want us to reconcile before the weekly revenue sync.

Ask: Ben/Marissa — please confirm ownership for any disputed opportunities and provide evidence (HubSpot timeline screenshot, form data, call notes). Proposed next steps below:
- Marissa: export of raw registration + form fields (attached).
- Ben: paste the HubSpot contact timeline or reply with the sequence that led to SQL.
- Vivek: estimate conversion lag and impact on next-quarter forecast if we reassign credit.

Goal: decide by EOD Tuesday so RevOps can lock attribution for the May board pack.

Thanks,

Thanks — I pulled the lead-level data and the HubSpot change history. Attached: MQL-to-SQL-rollup-2026Q2.xlsx and SF-bootcamp-leads.csv (sanitized). Summary: of the 22 MQLs, 12 explicitly have form value "referred_by: booth_demo"; 4 of the SQLs have the Booth Demo flag set as the Original Source in HS. For Acme (Jordan Ellis) the contact timeline shows: first session 3/28 (paid ad), form fill on 4/2 (checked booth_demo), UTM_campaign=sf-bootcamp; then AE outreach on 4/6 and demo on 4/8.

Our current HubSpot attribution model uses "first-touch + event_override" for event MQLs (we set an event property at registration). That is why Marketing is counting it toward the event. I agree that for revenue and sales forecasting we should consider last-touch or even an AE-driven override when there's an explicit sales conversion sequence.

Proposed reconciliation rule (short term):
- If AE creates the opportunity and has documented outreach that occurred after the event registration, assign 70% credit to Sales (last-touch) and 30% to Event Marketing (first-touch) for reportable pipeline numbers this quarter.
- Update HubSpot property "event_credit_split" on the opportunity and sync to RevOps.

I've added a column in the rollup sheet with suggested splits per-opportunity. See row for Jordan Ellis (Acme) marked 70/30.

If Ben is OK, I'll run the update script and sync to RevOps by Wednesday EOD.

—Marissa

1) Marissa — run the update script to set "event_credit_split" and push to RevOps (due: 2026-04-22 EOD). Please add a note on the opportunity timeline for each adjusted record.
